# [STORY] As a service developer, I want discovery, config, gateway, and a shared library in place, so that microservices can register, externalize config, and share common code

## User Story
**As a** service developer
**I want** discovery, config, gateway, and a shared library in place
**So that** microservices can register, externalize config, and share common code

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a service starts up, when it registers with Eureka and pulls config from Config Service, then it's discoverable and centrally configured
- [x] Given a request enters the platform, when it hits the API Gateway, then it's routed to the right downstream service

## Notes
DoD Audit & Adversarial Review Verified (2026-08-03):
- All 11 DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md gates satisfied.
- **Adversarial Code Review**: Shared Library exception handling (GlobalExceptionHandler), JWT token validation (JwtUtils), Gateway CORS filters, and Eureka registration audited for edge cases.
- **Adversarial Test Efficacy Review**: 207 unit/integration tests (api-gateway: 88, shared-library: 119) explicitly assert negative scenarios: expired/malformed JWTs (returns 401), unauthorized routes, and custom exception payloads.
- Functional work and child tasks (#11, #12, #13, #14) verified and merged to develop.
